lede: The Telluride Film Festival kicks off Friday and will have its usual grip on town through the long weekend, so plan accordingly if you're trying to get anywhere or get anything done. On the government side, the most concrete agenda item in front of any board this week is Mountain Village's Design Review Board on September 3rd, where a conditional-use permit for a temporary tent and food truck at 332 Adams Ranch Rd heads toward a recommendation to Town Council. Most other scheduled meetings — Norwood, Ridgway, the county — have no agendas posted yet, and the Norwood Water Commission has pushed its meeting to September 22nd.

notable.stake: DRB votes on conditional-use permit heading to Town Council for approval.
